title: Memory hog
description: A sandbox with 2 GiB and a task that eats memory: the memory watch must warn, then end the hog, and the sandbox must survive.

de.title: Speicherfresser
de.description: Eine Sandbox mit 2 GiB und eine Aufgabe, die Speicher frisst: Die Speicherüberwachung muss warnen, dann den Fresser beenden, und die Sandbox muss überleben.

prompt: Write and run /tmp/hog.py: it allocates 100 MB more every second and prints its size. While it runs, read /sandbox/session/memory.json every few seconds and print it. Report what happened to the hog and whether you (the agent) kept running.
